gloss: freely; at will; with complete mastery

cross_references.headword: {縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}
cross_references.label: in all directions, without limit

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) combining {自由|じゆう} (freedom) and {自在|じざい} (at will) for emphasis. Describes effortless mastery or unrestricted movement. Most commonly used adverbially with に.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}に{操|あやつ}る: to wield freely, to command with mastery
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}に{動|うご}く: to move freely
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}に{使|つか}いこなす: to use with complete skill
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}な{動|うご}き: free, unrestricted movement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自在|じざい}: freely, at will — the second half alone, slightly more literary
- {自由|じゆう}: free, freedom — broader meaning, not restricted to skill or mastery
- {縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}: in all directions, without limit — emphasizes range and reach

definitions.gloss: freely; at will; with complete mastery
definitions.explanation: being able to do something freely and effortlessly, as one pleases; having complete control or mastery over something

examples.japanese: {自由自在|じゆうじざい}に{動|うご}く。
{彼|かれ}は{英語|えいご}を{自由自在|じゆうじざい}に{操|あやつ}る。
examples.english: He commands English with complete fluency.

examples.japanese: このロボットは{自由自在|じゆうじざい}に{方向|ほうこう}を{変|か}えることができる。
examples.english: This robot can change direction freely.

examples.japanese: {熟練|じゅくれん}の{職人|しょくにん}は{道具|どうぐ}を{自由自在|じゆうじざい}に{使|つか}いこなす。
examples.english: A skilled craftsman handles tools with complete mastery.
